newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EKRANAS 1Q PROFIT UP, SALES DOWN.
newsitem.headline: EKRANAS 1Q PROFIT UP, SALES DOWN.

text.p: Lithuanian TV screen producer Ekranas said on Monday that its net profit for the first three months of this year was 4.9 million litas compared with 4.1 million litas for the corresponding period last year.
The company's sales for the first quarter of this year fell to 74.6 million litas from 88.5 million litas last year, Rimas Skaburskis, the company's chief accountant, told Reuters.
"This volume in sales is totally unacceptable for us," Skaburskis told Reuters.
"Sales fell because of the low exchange rate between the German mark and the U.S. dollar," he said.
The Lithuanian litas is pegged at a rate of four litas to one dollar.
"We plan to have a net profit of three million litas per month over the next three months and our second quarter profit will be no less than nine million litas," he added.
The company's 1996 net profit was 45.6 million litas and all of it was reinvested into the company to upgrade equipment.
Skaburskis said that the company planned to the same with its 1997 earnings.
The company is traded on the A list of the Vilnius bourse.
Its price on Monday inched up a hair to 6.50 litas from 6.49 litas.
